name: SPY weekly long-only vol-trailing Supertrend filter (x-bookmark scan, rank 1)
hypothesis: Holding SPY only while a weekly Supertrend (volatility-trailing) filter is bullish captures most of the index return with materially lower drawdown than buy-and-hold.

rules.entry: Long when the weekly Supertrend flips bullish.
rules.exit: Flat when the Supertrend flips bearish.
rules.position_sizing: All-in/out weekly in the scan model.
rules.risk_limits: None in scan model; JARVIS gates apply.
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Gross in scan; weekly turnover implies minimal cost drag.

known_failure_modes: 28.45% Monte Carlo 95th drawdown vs the 6.0% JARVIS floor — same floor-calibration question as the other monthly/weekly equity regime filters, not a strategy defect
71.6% time in market over 1,249 in-market trades / 21 buy signals; edge is drawdown-reduction, not return-enhancement (CAGR 7.99% < buy-and-hold 10.72%)
